source_title: Patreon Creators Heres How To Stop Apple From Keeping 30 Fee 0Ffe63Aaae1F

snippets.snippet_text: "If you're a Patreon creator and you've seen the recent news about Apple forcing Patreon to use in-app purchases on iOS, you probably had the same reaction everyone else did: 'Wait… does Apple now take 30% of my income?' Short answer: only if you let them. Apple has told Patreon that by November 2026, subscriptions sold inside the iOS app must use Apple's In-App Purchase system. Their system keeps 30% of the subscription price or 15% after one year of recurring subscriptions."
